title: Joint Output-Sensitivity Invalidation for Fast-WAM Optional IDM
hook: At matched cache-skip rates, a small change in the shared denoising feature can be more dangerous to the action output than a larger feature drift because the Optional-IDM video and action branches have different sensitivities; an observation-conditioned joint score should therefore rank unsafe reuses better than local feature drift. The predicted direction is higher rank correlation between this score and paired downstream action/video error, with lower error at the same skip rate.
hook_shape_rationale: This uses the surprising-empirical-reveal shape: the falsification metric is the rank correlation between the joint score and paired downstream error, directly challenging C3ache/WorldCache-style local-drift validity. A structural-reframe hook was viable, but it would merely rename an implicit cache assumption without establishing that the reframe changes closed-loop action and predicted-observation outcomes.

gap_closure.gap: No retrieved frontier leaf establishes an output-preserving validity condition for reusing intermediate representations after a changed receding observation: C3ache reuses residuals on a fixed cross-chunk cadence, while the action and predicted-video consequences of a stale residual are not jointly bounded — stakes: a closed-loop robot can issue stale actions after contact or motion changes, wasting expensive rollouts or causing task failure; intellectually, reported cache speedups cannot be transferred to WAM-Optional-IDM control without knowing when the approximation becomes invalid.
gap_closure.how_closed: The C04 move partitions cached block-timestep units by calibrated joint action/video influence, and the companion operator substitutes reuse for full recomputation only for the low-influence partition while invalidating the high-influence partition after an observation change.

core_mechanism: For each cached unit u=(b,k), where b is a Fast-WAM block and k is a denoising step, run a short calibration replay on the existing Optional-IDM checkpoint and compute branch influences I^a_u and I^v_u from the normalized action and predicted-observation changes caused by replacing u with its stale cached value under the same input. At a new receding observation, use the existing tensor h_{u,t} entering u and the cached source tensor h_{u,s} to compute the dimensionless context change d_{u,t}=||mean(h_{u,t})-mean(h_{u,s})||_2/(||mean(h_{u,s})||_2+eta), with eta only a numerical floor. The central object is the joint risk score S_{u,t}=lambda_a I^a_u d_{u,t}+lambda_v I^v_u d_{u,t}; I^a_u and I^v_u are normalized by their full-branch output norms, while lambda_a and lambda_v are named dimensionless weights. Reuse u only when S_{u,t} is at most the calibrated threshold tau_joint, the cache age is below H_max, and the Optional-IDM mode matches the source; otherwise invalidate u and recompute it from the current input. tau_joint is the largest held-out calibration threshold whose normalized joint discrepancy stays below epsilon_joint, with epsilon_joint=0.01 as the default tolerance and a held-out sweep as its selection rule; H_max defaults to one receding-observation interval and is increased only when the same held-out constraint remains satisfied. When a unit is recomputed, all downstream cached units that consume its output are marked dirty, so a stale upstream residual cannot contaminate the action or predicted-observation branch. The heterogeneous partition therefore preserves full computation for a small high-impact set and substitutes the cheaper cache operator only for units whose measured downstream influence and current context change jointly predict safe reuse. Unlike periodic cross-chunk reuse or video-only drift gating, the decision variable is tied to the two outputs that the validated Fast-WAM Optional-IDM path actually exposes.
core_mechanism_reasoning:
BLOCK 1 — PREMISES ledger:
P1. The shared tensor at each cached Fast-WAM block-timestep is the information path through which a changed observation can affect both Optional-IDM outputs; this is true because the action and predicted-observation branches consume the same denoising computation.
P2. Per-unit branch influence measured by stale-value replacement is sufficiently stable between calibration and deployment for a context-change score to rank safe versus unsafe reuse; untested — falsification target.
P3. Action and predicted-observation branches can assign unequal downstream importance to the same feature change; untested — falsification target, and this is why a single local feature-drift statistic is not assumed sufficient.
P4. Recomputing an upstream unit changes the inputs of its descendants, so descendant caches must be invalidated rather than independently trusted; untested — falsification target.
OBSERVATION-MODEL: inputs are policy-generated, receding robot observations from LIBERO and RoboTwin rollouts, with contact and motion changes selected by the deployed controller rather than IID random samples; calibration is stratified over nominal and change regimes and makes no unbiased-sampling claim.
ESTIMAND: the held-out expectation of normalized paired downstream discrepancy D_joint=lambda_a D_a+lambda_v D_v over one receding-observation transition, where D_a is action-vector MSE relative to uncached inference and D_v is pixel MSE of the predicted-observation clip relative to uncached inference.
The design explicitly avoids the method-lineage regression to local denoising-feature dynamics as a sufficient validity proxy; that proxy is measured only as a comparator.
BLOCK 2 — NAIVE-BASELINE AUDIT: the naive version is a periodic one-full-plus-cached-chunks schedule gated by local feature drift, as in the C3ache/WorldCache family. It fails under branch (i): policy-selected observation changes can leave local feature drift small while the action and predicted-observation readouts respond differently, so the naive statistic is a false sufficiency premise; the proposed mechanism confronts that failure by calibrating branch-specific influence and enforcing descendant invalidation. The standard-tool follow-up is that influence estimation or a JVP is not itself the contribution: the domain-specific structure is a shared Fast-WAM Optional-IDM action/video computation graph with receding feedback, a coupled downstream fidelity target, and no full pretraining or new labels.
BLOCK 3 — DESIGN RATIONALE: C04 was chosen because it makes the heterogeneity of cache-unit influence the load-bearing artifact, while architectural_operator_substitution turns that partition into a runnable reuse operator. Periodic schedules, video-only motion/saliency scores, and a learned cache policy were rejected because they either do not couple action fidelity to predicted-observation fidelity, require an additional training resource, or do not supply an explicit observation-triggered invalidation rule; the existing Fast-WAM checkpoint, validated Optional-IDM path, PyTorch runtime, and LIBERO/RoboTwin traces are sufficient resources.
core_mechanism_steps:
1. Freeze the existing Fast-WAM checkpoint and validated Optional-IDM path; collect a calibration split and a held-out split of receding-observation rollouts from LIBERO and RoboTwin, recording the cached unit ids, source tensors, action vectors, and predicted-observation clips.
2. For each unit u=(b,k), replay the calibration traces with the unit replaced by its stale cached value while all other inputs stay fixed, then compute I^a_u and I^v_u as the mean normalized action and predicted-observation changes; output one influence table keyed by (b,k).
3. Set lambda_a=lambda_v=1 as the default normalized branch weights, set epsilon_joint=0.01 as the default joint-discrepancy tolerance, and choose tau_joint and H_max on the held-out calibration split as the largest threshold and age that satisfy the tolerance; sweep these named parameters rather than hiding fixed gates.
4. In each new receding-observation inference, run the unchanged prefix needed to form h_{u,t} at every candidate cache unit and compare it with the source h_{u,s}; output the normalized context change d_{u,t}.
5. Compute S_{u,t}=lambda_a I^a_u d_{u,t}+lambda_v I^v_u d_{u,t} and test the explicit validity rule: reuse only when S_{u,t}<=tau_joint, cache age<=H_max, and the Optional-IDM mode is unchanged.
6. For a failed test, recompute u using the current observation and action context, replace its cached tensor and source fingerprint, and emit the updated intermediate to the original downstream action/video graph; no auxiliary predictor or retraining is introduced.
7. Mark every descendant cache unit that consumes a recomputed output dirty, and force a fresh computation at reset or mode change; this propagates invalidation to the final action and predicted-observation outputs instead of allowing stale residual chains.
8. Measure uncached Fast-WAM Optional-IDM, a periodic C3ache-style cache, and the proposed cache at matched skip rates on the held-out rollouts using native GPU event timing and wall-clock traces, together with action MSE, predicted-observation MSE, and closed-loop task success.
falsification_prediction: Run the same existing Fast-WAM Optional-IDM checkpoint on held-out LIBERO and RoboTwin receding-observation rollouts, comparing uncached inference, a periodic cross-chunk cache, and the proposed cache at matched skip rates while recording native GPU latency. If the mechanism is correct, the rank correlation between S_{u,t} and paired downstream discrepancy D_joint will be higher than the local-drift comparator, and the proposed cache will lower both action MSE and predicted-observation MSE relative to the periodic cache without lowering closed-loop task success. The single load-bearing variable is S_{u,t}; a negative control permutes the calibrated influence vectors I^a_u,I^v_u across cache units while preserving the threshold and observed skip rate, and should remove the proposed advantage in downstream task success and D_joint rather than merely changing S_{u,t} itself. Failure of the score to predict downstream error, or failure of the joint invalidation rule to preserve both outputs at matched reuse, falsifies the candidate's validity claim even if a latency reduction remains.
compute_budget: 2-4 A100 GPUs; approximately 8 A100-GPU-days total for calibration, native latency profiling, and held-out LIBERO/RoboTwin evaluation using the existing checkpoint, with no full pretraining; $0 API because all inference and evaluation are local.

differentiation_from_lit.delta: C3ache reuses same-denoising-step action-expert residuals on a periodic cross-chunk cadence, whereas this candidate derives a per-unit observation-conditioned invalidation decision from paired action and predicted-observation influence and propagates dirty states through the Optional-IDM graph.

EfficientVLA caches intermediate attention/MLP outputs inside a CogACT diffusion action head, whereas this candidate tests changed receding observations on Fast-WAM Optional IDM and preserves a jointly measured action-plus-predicted-observation output rather than only action success.

The heterogeneous-token WorldCache uses curvature-guided token prediction and video rollout quality, whereas this candidate partitions Fast-WAM cache units by calibrated downstream branch influence and invalidates from a coupled control/video risk score.

The content-aware WorldCache uses motion, saliency, blending, and phase scheduling for video-world-model fidelity, whereas this candidate's validity target is the paired action and predicted-observation error after a receding observation changes, with native closed-loop evaluation.

VLA-Cache reuses adjacent-frame visual KV tokens using visual stability and task-region selection, whereas this candidate reuses Fast-WAM Optional-IDM denoising units only after an output-coupled invalidation test that includes the action branch and descendant cache dependencies.

what_step_was_missed: C3ache would need to replace its periodic cross-chunk cadence with a per-unit score whose input is the changed receding observation, calibrate separate action and predicted-observation influence, and propagate invalidation from a recomputed unit through dependent Optional-IDM blocks; without this step, same-denoising-step residual reuse cannot distinguish a benign motion change from a control-critical one.
signature_terms: observation conditioned cross chunk residual cache
